data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add --no-strata flag to /dso:onboarding for graceful skip when prompts/strata/ is absent (older plugin versions). Without the flag and with prompts/strata/ missing, emit explicit error `[A2] requires prompts/strata/ from plugin v<min>+; update plugin or pass --no-strata`. STRATA_SKIP signal: --no-strata writes `strata.skip=true` to dso-config.conf so sprint/brainstorm/preplanning check it for graceful degradation. Documented one-liner: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/detect-strata.sh && /dso:onboarding --resume=strata-only` re-runs detection + four sub-files without re-running other phases.
**Why**: Version-skew between plugin and host project must degrade gracefully; resume path lets users retro-apply Strata awareness without full re-onboarding.
**Scope**:
- IN: Flag parsing; absence-detection error path; strata.skip key write; downstream consumers (sprint/brainstorm/preplanning) honoring strata.skip; --resume=strata-only mode.
- OUT: Modifying sprint/brainstorm/preplanning beyond the strata.skip read.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, missing prompts/strata/ without --no-strata produces the named error ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, --no-strata writes strata.skip=true and skips Strata Reads ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, --resume=strata-only re-runs detection + four sub-files without re-running other phases ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, sprint/brainstorm/preplanning gracefully degrade when strata.skip=true is set ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for each path

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Absence-detection at fail-fast time; named error is greppable

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, --no-strata flag, STRATA_SKIP signal, version-skew error, and resume one-liner work
